weekly.label: Aug 10–15
weekly.headline: Quality over volume — Neighbor DC held and a 10-agent proposal out the door.
highlights: Neighbor (Mark Bailey) — DC held Aug 14, 10-agent Manila second-site proposal delivered (~$16,491/mo, 90-day 50% refund guarantee).
Moved off the plain cost-benchmark line to pain-point angles per vertical: property management (cost per door), trades/HVAC, trucking, law firms, wealth, insurance, mortgage, CPA, RCM.
Thriviae and Deltabit both in delivery; Humana relationship-building continues with Matt Rowley.

weekly.label: Aug 3–8
weekly.headline: Humana discovery call held; outreach running across email and LinkedIn.
highlights: Humana DC ran Aug 4 — Matt Rowley (Global Supplier Services) came in warm off the approved-vendor outreach.
125 new LinkedIn connections on a free account — no InMail or Sales Navigator.
Thriviae kickoff done (SDR/BDR); Deltabit candidate interviews underway.

weekly.label: Jul 27–31
weekly.headline: Two deposits settled and moved into delivery.
highlights: Deltabit and Thriviae deposits both settled — Deltabit into interviews, Thriviae kickoff booked.
Nine cold waves into fresh verticals: insurance verification, credentialing, prior auth, CPA, AP, customer support, loan ops.

weekly.label: Jul 20–25
weekly.headline: No calls on the calendar, so outreach compounded — Humana DC booked.
highlights: A vendor-manager contact (Kelli McDaniel) referred us into Humana's Global Supplier Services — booked DC for Aug 4.
Three quiet leads reconnected: Glimcher, Clarify Health, and Temu (after nearly a year of follow-ups).
Outreach started auto-logging to HubSpot via BCC, so every send lands in the CRM.

weekly.label: Jul 13–18
weekly.headline: Stood up a four-channel outbound engine in one week.
highlights: ~840 personalised, HubSpot-deduped emails across three campaigns plus a new LinkedIn channel.
Vendor-accreditation intelligence gathered — the approved-vendor angle became the best door-opener.
An active referral deal closing and a warm referral in play.
